papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.summary: A transformer replaces recurrence with multi-head self attention for sequence transduction. Positional encodings retain token order while parallel computation supports translation.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.summary: Bidirectional transformer representations learn from masked language modeling and next sentence prediction. Fine tuning adapts a pretrained encoder to downstream language understanding.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.summary: A generator conditions on documents retrieved from an external corpus. Combining parametric model knowledge with nonparametric retrieval supports knowledge intensive question answering.

papers.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
papers.summary: Dual encoders embed questions and passages into a shared vector space. Contrastive training and hard negative examples improve dense retrieval for open domain question answering.

papers.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
papers.summary: Token level embeddings and a late interaction maximum similarity operator enable contextual passage ranking while document representations are precomputed.

papers.title: BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
papers.summary: A heterogeneous information retrieval benchmark evaluates generalization across domains and tasks. Sparse retrieval, dense retrieval and reranking are compared in zero shot settings.

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Freezing pretrained weights and learning low rank update matrices reduces trainable parameters during adaptation of large language models.

papers.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.summary: Four bit quantization, low rank adapters and memory saving optimizations enable efficient fine tuning of large language models with reduced GPU memory.

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
papers.summary: An IO aware tiled attention algorithm reduces transfers between GPU memory and on chip storage. Exact attention computation uses less memory and improves throughput.

papers.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
papers.summary: Improved work partitioning and parallelism accelerate exact attention on GPUs while reducing non matrix multiplication operations.

papers.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
papers.summary: A compact student learns soft probability targets from a larger teacher. Temperature scaled distributions transfer information beyond hard class labels.

papers.title: DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT: smaller, faster, cheaper and lighter
papers.summary: Knowledge distillation compresses a pretrained language encoder using teacher predictions and representation alignment for efficient downstream inference.

papers.title: SimCLR: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
papers.summary: Contrastive learning pulls augmented views of the same image together and separates other images. Data augmentation and a projection head support self supervised representation learning.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.summary: Residual skip connections let deep convolutional networks learn corrections to input representations, improving optimization of image recognition networks.

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.summary: An image is divided into patches and processed as a token sequence by a transformer. Large scale pretraining supports visual recognition.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.summary: A forward process adds noise to data and a learned reverse process removes it. Iterative denoising generates images from random noise.

papers.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
papers.summary: Supervised instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback align language model outputs with human preferences.

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.summary: Preference pairs directly optimize a language model through a classification style objective, avoiding a separately trained reward model and reinforcement learning loop.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Examples containing intermediate reasoning steps improve performance on arithmetic and symbolic tasks through chain of thought prompting.

papers.title: Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels
papers.summary: Hypothetical document embeddings use a generated document to guide retrieval without labeled relevance pairs. The hypothetical text is encoded to search a document corpus.

papers.title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
papers.summary: Siamese and triplet training produce sentence embeddings compared with cosine similarity for semantic search and sentence similarity.

papers.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
papers.summary: A language model learns reflection tokens to decide when to retrieve evidence and critique generated text for relevance and support.

evaluation.warning: Curated development toy set; not an independent benchmark or generalization claim. Latency excludes indexing/model load.
